description: GitHub Actions pins: weekly, no automerge. Hex packages: security only (#1002). Runs on the self-hosted Forgejo (renovate/renovate-config); covers .forgejo/workflows and .github/workflows.

mix is security-only: no version update and no lock-file maintenance. When osv.dev lists an advisory against the mix.lock version of a dependency that mix.exs lists, and a release within its mix.exs requirement, as Renovate reads it, fixes it, the alert re-enables that dependency and Renovate opens one security PR that runs `mix deps.update <package>` and leaves mix.exs as it is. A fix outside that reading (in-range-only), a transitive package or an advisory with no fix gets no PR. Renovate reads `~> 0.N` as below 0.(N+1).0, where Mix reads below 1.0.0: a 0.x fix in a later minor is outside that reading, and so is every fix for req or tailwind, locked past it.

constraints pins that run's toolchain to the CI workflow's erlef/setup-beam steps. containerbase names an OTP build with four numbers, so OTP 29.1.2 is 29.1.2.0 (test/code_health/beam_version_pins_test.exs).
